en: A colorized vintage view over the rooftops of a European city with a river in the middle ground and a steep, green hill crowned by fortifications and a clock/bell tower. Along the riverbank runs a row of grand, white and pastel townhouses. Two baroque church towers with onion domes rise in the foreground. At the top of the image is printed red text identifying the scene as Graz and the riverside street with the Schlossberg hill behind.
